# Xbox
> Xbox is Microsoft’s gaming platform for consoles, PC, cloud gaming, subscriptions, accessories, and a large cross-device game catalog.

Xbox.com is the central destination for Xbox hardware, Game Pass, digital games, cloud play, accessories, support, and developer-facing platform information. It covers Xbox Series X|S consoles, PC gaming, handheld and mobile play, account services, and official help resources.

## Core Platform
- [Xbox Home](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA): Main Xbox landing page for games, hardware, Game Pass, and ecosystem features.
- [Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games): Browse Xbox games, releases, collections, and store-linked game discovery pages.
- [PC Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/pc-game-pass): Subscription page for PC Game Pass benefits, catalog, and membership details.
- [Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass): Overview of Game Pass plans, included benefits, and supported devices.
- [Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/cloud-gaming): Xbox Cloud Gaming overview for streaming supported games across devices.
- [Devices](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/devices): Xbox experiences across console, PC, mobile, TVs, and other supported hardware.

## Consoles
- [Xbox Consoles](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles): Overview of Xbox console lineup, features, and comparison entry points.
- [Xbox Series X](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/xbox-series-x): Product page for the flagship Xbox Series X console and specifications.
- [Xbox Series S](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/xbox-series-s): Product page for the compact all-digital Xbox Series S console.
- [Compare Consoles](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/compare): Side-by-side comparison of Xbox console models and key hardware differences.
- [Xbox All Access](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-all-access): Financing program bundling an Xbox console with Game Pass Ultimate.
- [Console Accessories](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories): Official accessories catalog including controllers, headsets, and storage products.

## Game Pass & Membership
- [Xbox Game Pass Plans](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass): Membership overview with plan options, pricing, and included benefits.
- [Game Pass Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/games): Search and browse the current Game Pass game catalog.
- [PC Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/pc-game-pass): PC-focused Game Pass membership page with included titles and benefits.
- [Xbox Game Pass Ultimate](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/ultimate): Premium Game Pass tier with cloud gaming, online multiplayer, and more.
- [Deals with Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/deals): Member discounts and purchase savings available through Game Pass.
- [EA Play with Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/ea-play): EA Play benefits available through eligible Game Pass memberships.

## Games & Discovery
- [Xbox Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games): Main games hub for discovery, categories, and featured releases.
- [Free-to-Play Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/free-to-play): Collection of free-to-play games available on Xbox platforms.
- [Optimized for Xbox Series X|S](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/optimized): Games enhanced for Xbox Series X|S performance and visual features.
- [Backward Compatible Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/backward-compatibility): Information and catalog access for backward compatible Xbox titles.
- [Xbox Play Anywhere](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/xbox-play-anywhere): Program for eligible games shared across Xbox console and Windows PC.
- [Coming Soon to Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/games#coming-soon): Upcoming Game Pass additions and recently announced titles.

## Cloud, PC & Cross-Device Play
- [Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/cloud-gaming): Stream Xbox games on supported phones, tablets, browsers, and TVs.
- [Devices](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/devices): Overview of where Xbox can be played across hardware categories.
- [PC Gaming with Xbox](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/pc-gaming): Xbox gaming experience on Windows PCs, services, and game access.
- [Mobile Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/mobile-gaming): Xbox gaming options and services available on mobile devices.
- [Remote Play](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/remote-play): Stream installed console games to supported devices using Remote Play.
- [Xbox App for Windows PC](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/apps/xbox-app-for-pc): Desktop app for discovering, installing, and managing Xbox PC games.

## Accessories & Hardware
- [Accessories](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories): Official Xbox accessories hub for controllers, audio, and storage.
- [Xbox Wireless Controller](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories/controllers/xbox-wireless-controller): Standard Xbox wireless controller product page and feature overview.
- [Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories/controllers/elite-wireless-controller-series-2): Premium customizable controller with advanced inputs and profiles.
- [Xbox Stereo Headset](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories/headsets/xbox-stereo-headset): Official wired headset product page with audio feature details.
- [Xbox Wireless Headset](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories/headsets/xbox-wireless-headset): Official wireless headset with Xbox and Bluetooth connectivity support.
- [Storage Expansion Card](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/accessories/hard-drives/seagate-expansion-card): Official expandable storage option for Xbox Series X|S consoles.

## Apps & Account
- [Xbox App for Mobile](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/apps/xbox-app-for-mobile): Mobile app for social features, captures, remote installs, and account access.
- [Xbox App for Windows PC](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/apps/xbox-app-for-pc): Windows app for PC Game Pass, library management, and social features.
- [Xbox Family Settings App](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/apps/family-settings-app): Parental controls app for managing child accounts and play settings.
- [Sign In](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/live): Entry point for Xbox account and service-related sign-in flows.
- [Redeem Code](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/redeem): Redeem Xbox gift cards, subscriptions, and digital content codes.
- [Xbox Status](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-live-status): Live service status for Xbox network, gaming, and account systems.

## Support
- [Xbox Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA): Official support home for setup, billing, hardware, and troubleshooting.
- [Xbox Live Status](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-live-status): Current operational status for Xbox online services and features.
- [Set Up Your Xbox Console](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/help/hardware-network/console/set-up-new-series-x-s): Setup guidance for new Xbox Series X|S consoles.
- [Manage Subscriptions](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/help/subscriptions-billing/manage-subscriptions/viewing-and-managing-your-memberships): Help for viewing and managing Xbox memberships and recurring billing.
- [Controller Troubleshooting](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/help/hardware-network/controller): Support articles for pairing, updating, and fixing Xbox controllers.
- [Accessibility Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/help/account-profile/accessibility): Accessibility help and guidance for Xbox hardware and services.

## Developers & Publishing
- [ID@Xbox](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/publish): Self-publishing program information for independent game developers.
- [Microsoft Game Dev](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/games/): Developer hub for Xbox, PC, cloud, tools, and publishing resources.
- [Game Stack](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/games/products/game-stack/): Microsoft game development solutions for services, tools, and infrastructure.
- [GDK Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/gdk/): Microsoft Game Development Kit documentation for Xbox and Windows development.
- [Xbox Services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/gdk/_content/gc/live/): Documentation for Xbox services, identity, multiplayer, and platform features.
- [Partner Center for Games](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/game-publishing/tutorial-xbox-managed/how-to-create-a-product-in-partner-center): Publishing workflow documentation for Xbox game products and submissions.

## News & Community
- [Xbox Wire](https://news.xbox.com/en-ca/): Official Xbox news site for announcements, releases, and platform updates.
- [Game Pass News](https://news.xbox.com/en-ca/tag/xbox-game-pass/): Official Xbox Wire posts related to Game Pass announcements and updates.
- [Xbox on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/xbox): Official Xbox video channel for trailers, showcases, and feature updates.
- [Xbox on Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/xbox): Official Xbox livestream channel for events and community broadcasts.
- [Xbox on Discord](https://discord.gg/xbox): Official Xbox community Discord for discussion and announcements.
- [Xbox on X](https://x.com/Xbox): Official Xbox social account for news, events, and product updates.
